title: mess is mine
ao3_summary: He bites the inside of his cheek, almost like he’s debating something. “Gamora…” She steps around him without another word. “I begged to work with you.” His voice is urgent. title: The strange man of Knowhere
ao3_summary: Peter is acting strange. Gamora is worried, and the Avengers are both confused and shocked. When they reached Knowhere his instincts were screaming at him that something wasn’t right. It was too quiet and he felt more on edge than usual. He noticed Gamora watching him and he ignored it. He had a feeling she’d noticed something was off about him. He wasn’t sure what it was, but something inside of him had shifted recently and even though he tried to push it down and ignore it. Whatever it was wanted out and he was scared to know what that meant.
